facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit had a dream. He wanted to hop. He wanted to play. He wanted to be real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: After hearing the old horse's story, the rabbit had a dream. He wanted to be real so he could hop and play. He imagined running through the green grass freely. Every night, the boy hugged him tight before sleeping. The rabbit felt warm and loved in the boy's arms. He believed that love would make his dream come true.
facts.Word cards: boy = 소년 / loved = 사랑했다 / rabbit = 토끼 / together = 함께
